caseStudies.title: Deliver My Project
caseStudies.summary: A structured delivery path that helps turn a project requirement into a clear, actionable delivery request.
caseStudies.businessNeed: Create a clear path for clients to explain what they need, what outcome they expect, their timeline, and budget.
caseStudies.outcome: A clearer project intake process that improves communication and gives both sides a stronger starting point for delivery.
caseStudies.businessValue: Better project clarity, stronger communication, and a more structured route from request to delivery.

caseStudies.title: Mentor Me
caseStudies.summary: A focused mentoring path designed to help people make better technology and delivery decisions.
caseStudies.businessNeed: Provide practical guidance when a technology, delivery, or ownership decision needs experienced input.
caseStudies.outcome: A focused conversation that helps clarify priorities, identify next steps, and reduce uncertainty.
caseStudies.businessValue: Faster decision-making, clearer priorities, and better use of time and resources.

caseStudies.title: Coffee With Me
caseStudies.summary: A simple conversation path for exploring an opportunity, challenge, or next step.
caseStudies.businessNeed: Create an easy way to start a useful conversation before committing to a larger engagement.
caseStudies.outcome: A focused discussion that identifies the opportunity, challenge, and most useful next step.
caseStudies.businessValue: Clearer expectations, stronger communication, and a better foundation for future collaboration.
